findings.description: Pietro Marchetti and Maria Aquilini had a daughter, Giuseppa Marchetti, born in 1884 at Maglianello, Rieti, who died at Rieti on 15 June 1913; the civil death registration names her parents as Pietro and Maria Aquilini.
supporting_sources: Italy, Rieti, Civil Registration (State Archive), 1840-1945 — death registration of Giuseppa Marchetti, Rieti, 15 Jun 1913, born 1884 at Maglianello, parents Pietro and Maria Aquilini
